Counsel for Applicant :- Sushil Kumar Pandey,Atul Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed in Court today, is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicants in case crime No. 150/2003, under Sections 498A, 304B, 201 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, police station Kakrauli, District Muzaffar Nagar with the prayer to enlarge the applicants on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants-accused are brothers-in-law (Dewars) of deceased and they have not committed any offence.
It was submitted that the marriage of deceased with brother of applicants has taken place on 26.02.2003 and that alleged incident took place on 12.11.2003.
The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased made against the applicants and their family members are thoroughly false.

sentences.text: It is submitted that in this case charge-sheet was filed on 31.01.2004 without arrest of applicants and thereafter in committal proceedings, no summon or warrant was served upon the applicants and that for the first time non-bailable warrants were issued against the applicant on 06.10.2022.
Applicants have surrendered before the court on 20.10.2022 and thereafter case was committed to the court of Session.
The three material witnesses have already been examined before the trial court and they did not support the prosecution version and turn hostile.

Referring to the facts of the matter, it is submitted that the applicants are brothers-in-law (Dewars) of deceased and that the incident took place in the year 2003 and that material witnesses have already been examined.

Lastly, it was argued that the applicants are in judicial custody since 20.10.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case, applicants are enlarged on bail, the applicants will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for bail.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let applicants Saleem and Nadeem involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicants will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
2. The applicants will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
3. The applicants will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicants will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicants, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 19.4.2023 Anand  Saleem And Another vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80706339/
